client: Fernwood Pantry
client_industry: e-commerce
start: 2025-07
end: 2025-10
engagement: hourly
stack:

metrics:

The review is from: Fernwood Pantry

text: Tobias did solid work on our subscription box billing backend. He moved 6.5k subscribers off a legacy plugin onto Stripe Billing and set up a retry queue for failed card payments, which helped us recover 31% of failed payments. He was straightforward to work with and handled the project well from start to finish.
